Interface DbSupportCreator

All Known Implementing Classes:
H2DbSupportCreator
public interface DbSupportCreator
Should be at least one of these for a supported database. It creates a DbSupport that works with the database specified by the DatabaseMetaData. These are placed in META-INF using an annotation like 
@ServiceProvider(path="SS/DbSupport/H2", service=DbSupportCreator.class)
Note in this example that dbMeta.getDatabaseProductName().equals("H2").

Any DbSupportCreators found are tried in order. The first creator that matches the metadata returns non null, the search is terminated and that value is returned. Normally position is not used with the annotation, but if there are multiple creators that match, it's use might be needed. See @ServiceProvider javadoc.
